descriptionHtml:
Orico 2577U3-V1 2.5 Inch USB 3.0 Micro-B Hard Drive Enclosure Black Edition (Supports Up to 6TB Capacity / Tool-Free Installation / 5Gbps USB 3.0 Micro-B Interface / High-Quality ABS Material / 0.5m Cable Included)

Turn your 2.5-inch SATA hard drive or solid-state drive into a powerful high-capacity portable storage device with the Orico 2577U3-V1 USB 3.0 Micro-B Enclosure in Black, available at Turbo Computer EgyptCrafted from durable ABS heat-resistant material with a tool-free slide setup, this enclosure supports massive drive capacities up to 6TB and high-speed data transfer rates up to 5Gbps via USB 3.0 Micro-B interface.
